validity.researcher_notes: The pipe and the rebuild are real. A 2025 occupation-authority order and a June 2025 notice both name the Taganrog-Mariupol Ду700 trunk. This row is the rebuilt part of the old trunk on row P1457, so it is not a duplicate of it but a replacement stretch. The documented rebuilt stretch is 42.625 km, well under the roughly 104 km route estimate. The order is dated 2025 but cites planning papers first approved in 2020.
